scripts.build: pnpm build:controller && pnpm build:ui && pnpm build:react && pnpm registry:build && pnpm build:storybook
scripts.build:ui: ng build emr-ui && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='dist/emr-ui/package.json';const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));if(j.peerDependencies?.['@drguptavivek/emr-controller']?.startsWith('workspace:'))j.peerDependencies['@drguptavivek/emr-controller']='^'+j.version;fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n');"
scripts.site: pnpm build:controller && pnpm registry:build && pnpm --filter @drguptavivek/emr-react harness:next
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm build:controller && pnpm check:node-controller && pnpm build:ui && pnpm check:ssr && pnpm check:react && pnpm build:react && pnpm registry:build && pnpm check:stories
scripts.release:dry-run: pnpm check && pnpm --dir packages/emr-controller publish --dry-run --no-git-checks && pnpm --dir dist/emr-ui publish --dry-run --no-git-checks && pnpm --dir packages/emr-react publish --dry-run --no-git-checks
scripts.release:publish: pnpm check && pnpm --dir packages/emr-controller publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --dir dist/emr-ui publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --dir packages/emr-react publish --access public --no-git-checks
